# ADR-3098: A09: Log retention days setting for audit lane 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Short retention destroys forensics value.

## Decision

Audit configuration SHALL declare a log retention days setting for audit lane 2 (A09-2).

## Consequences

Retention meets legal and detection needs.
